name: Forte Metals
verdict: Forte Metals saw no paid activity across Meta or Google Ads in the last 28 days, so all engagement came from Google Business Profile, which logged 87 total actions (12 calls, 51 directions, 24 web clicks). The biggest movement is a 57.69% drop in GBP actions over the last 7 days versus the prior 7 days, likely driven by reduced organic search demand or a lull in local intent activity with no paid support to supplement visibility.

performance.verdict: No paid spend active; GBP organic is the only revenue signal and it's fading.
